title: Figure 9: NASA Langley wing-cylinder configuration WB-004 with critical areas annotated
description: Gray shaded rendering of a winged cylindrical spacecraft titled "NASA Langley Wing-Cylinder Configuration Concept WB-004," with a red-orange band marking cylinder heating and callouts such as "Complex curved TPS system," "Glide angle of attack very high ~ 45°," "Unsymmetrical vortices can produce supersonic control problems," "Cylinder heating extends up to 55° to 60°," "Poor hypersonic lift-to-drag ratio limits glide range" and "Thin wings encounter severe heating from both sides i.e. 'hot structure'." Caption: "Figure 9. NASA Langley Wing-Body Configuration WB-004 With Generally Critical Areas for Wing Bodies Identified."
